description_en: Queries the IDs of the workspaces on which a specific Alibaba Cloud account or RAM user has permissions in a specific region
description_zh: 该接口用于查询指定阿里云账号（包括阿里云主账号或RAM用户）在目标地域下拥有角色权限的DataWorks工作空间的ID列表
name: ListProjectIds

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the desired Alibaba Cloud account.

You can log on to the DataWorks (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner to view the ID
parameters.help_zh:
目标阿里云账号ID。

您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，鼠标悬停至顶部菜单栏右侧的用户头像，获取账号ID
parameters.name: user_id

ProjectIds.description_en: The IDs of the DataWorks workspaces. The IDs of the workspaces on which the desired Alibaba Cloud account has permissions were returned
ProjectIds.description_zh:
返回的DataWorks工作空间ID列表。

返回结果为目标阿里云账号所拥有角色权限的DataWorks工作空间的ID列表，此处仅以一个工作空间ID示例

items.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
